snippet.title: Petal - Official Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Play here: https://13-23.itch.io/petal

Petal is a short indie horror game. Because my keyboard broke, I developed this entire game using only my mouse and the Windows virtual keyboard. Playable right in your browser!
